text: Valverde valley, one in the afternoon. A wildfire has broken out on Pine Hill, and a strong north-east wind is pushing it towards the village of Pineta.
caption: Valverde valley, one in the afternoon. A wildfire has broken out on Pine Hill, and a strong north-east wind is pushing it towards the village of Pineta.

text: Four people run the response: the exercise director, the mayor of Valverde, the fire commander, and a regional civil protection officer who works in Armenian.
caption: Four people run the response: the exercise director, the mayor of Valverde, the fire commander, and a regional civil protection officer who works in Armenian.

text: The exercise begins. The fire already covers five hectares and is spreading south-west through dry pine forest.
caption: The exercise begins. The fire already covers five hectares and is spreading south-west through dry pine forest.

text: The first reports come in: emergency calls about the fire, a warning that the primary school is in session, and a fire-behaviour estimate for the commander.
caption: The first reports come in: emergency calls about the fire, a warning that the primary school is in session, and a fire-behaviour estimate for the commander.

text: In Pineta, 120 pupils and staff are still inside the primary school, and the school has no transport of its own.
caption: In Pineta, 120 pupils and staff are still inside the primary school, and the school has no transport of its own.

text: The mayor acts at once: warn the village, evacuate the school to the sports centre in Valverde, and close the northern road.
caption: The mayor acts at once: warn the village, evacuate the school to the sports centre in Valverde, and close the northern road.

text: The fire commander sends ground crews to cut fire breaks north and east of the village, and an air tanker to wet the forest above it.
caption: The fire commander sends ground crews to cut fire breaks north and east of the village, and an air tanker to wet the forest above it.

text: Before anything happens on the ground, every order is checked against the people, vehicles and authority actually available.
caption: Before anything happens on the ground, every order is checked against the people, vehicles and authority actually available.

text: A problem emerges: evacuating the school needs 3 buses, and the town has only 2.
caption: A problem emerges: evacuating the school needs 3 buses, and the town has only 2.

text: Exercise control steps in: the regional transport company can release one more bus.
caption: Exercise control steps in: the regional transport company can release one more bus.

text: The extra bus is confirmed, and the mayor is told it is on its way.
caption: The extra bus is confirmed, and the mayor is told it is on its way.

text: The fire commander's plan goes ahead: two fire breaks and a water drop.
caption: The fire commander's plan goes ahead: two fire breaks and a water drop.

text: With three buses available, the school evacuation can start, together with a warning to the whole village.
caption: With three buses available, the school evacuation can start, together with a warning to the whole village.

text: The mayor receives the confirmation, and the buses head for the school.
caption: The mayor receives the confirmation, and the buses head for the school.

text: The next thirty minutes unfold. The fire runs downhill towards Pineta while the crews race to finish the breaks.
caption: The next thirty minutes unfold. The fire runs downhill towards Pineta while the crews race to finish the breaks.

text: The tallest flames mark where the fire burns hottest and where most simulated runs agree. The faint glow ahead shows where it could spread next.
caption: The tallest flames mark where the fire burns hottest and where most simulated runs agree. The faint glow ahead shows where it could spread next.

text: The fire breaks hold at the edge of the village, and the children reach the sports centre safely. The northern road is lost to the flames.
caption: The fire breaks hold at the edge of the village, and the children reach the sports centre safely. The northern road is lost to the flames.

text: Each responder receives a report on what has changed on the ground.
caption: Each responder receives a report on what has changed on the ground.

text: Half past one. The wind strengthens to 55 kilometres per hour, and a second fire starts in the farmland south-east of Pineta.
caption: Half past one. The wind strengthens to 55 kilometres per hour, and a second fire starts in the farmland south-east of Pineta.

text: Local resources are stretched. Regional civil protection asks for international help: two water-bombing aircraft through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism, and two more ground crews.
caption: Local resources are stretched. Regional civil protection asks for international help: two water-bombing aircraft through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism, and two more ground crews.

text: Under pressure, the fire commander sends an unclear order…
caption: Under pressure, the fire commander sends an unclear order…

text: …and is asked exactly where the crews should go, instead of anyone guessing.
caption: …and is asked exactly where the crews should go, instead of anyone guessing.

text: The answer comes back: the eastern edge of the village, and the slope above it.
caption: The answer comes back: the eastern edge of the village, and the slope above it.

text: The request for aircraft and the new fire breaks are approved; the unclear order is sent back.
caption: The request for aircraft and the new fire breaks are approved; the unclear order is sent back.

text: The next hour. Reinforcements arrive and the breaks keep the fire out of Pineta, but the second fire races through the farmland, where nobody was warned.
caption: The next hour. Reinforcements arrive and the breaks keep the fire out of Pineta, but the second fire races through the farmland, where nobody was warned.

text: By half past two, Pineta is safe and every child is accounted for, but farmhouses have burned and the aircraft are still on their way. Every decision and its consequences are recorded for the debrief.
caption: By half past two, Pineta is safe and every child is accounted for, but farmhouses have burned and the aircraft are still on their way. Every decision and its consequences are recorded for the debrief.
